name: connection.hello
description: Handshake. First verb on a new connection; required before any other verb is accepted.

client_version.description: Protocol version the client wishes to speak, e.g. '2.0'. Server picks the highest mutually-supported version and echoes it in the response.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier — always the literal "arh" (Agent Remote Hands). Lets clients verify the wire protocol upfront.

version.description: Protocol version the agent negotiated for this connection, e.g. "2.2". Echoes the highest mutually-supported version.

server.description: Agent product family, e.g. "windows-modern" or "windows-classic". Mirrors `system.info.server`.

session_id.description: Fresh per-connection identifier for log correlation; opaque to the client.

x-implementations.name: agent_native
x-implementations.description: Handled inline by the agent's wire-framing / lifecycle layer. No OS-level backend; no fallback possible.

windows-modern.description: Agent-internal lifecycle verb; no Windows-specific behaviour. The handshake runs in the agent's framing thread before any OS call.

windows-classic.description: Agent-internal lifecycle verb; no Windows-specific behaviour. The handshake runs in the agent's framing thread before any OS call.
